final: WITH expense_totals AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total_cost, COUNT(*) AS expense_count FROM expense GROUP BY link_to_budget), average_spend AS (SELECT AVG(spent) AS amount FROM budget) SELECT AVG(e.total_cost) AS average_total, SUM(e.expense_count) AS total_expenses, AVG(e.total_cost - a.amount) AS average_amount_above_spend FROM expense_totals e CROSS JOIN average_spend a WHERE e.total_cost > a.amount
